_comment: Deterministic synthetic GTFS-RT payloads for docker-heap-bench's RT-poller capture lane (--rt-poller-mode fixture).
_whyPinnedAndNotLive: A poller-on/off capture pair runs sequentially. Immutable local payloads prevent upstream feed drift from entering the delta and provide a known merged-entry denominator.
_whatTheSnapshotActuallyStores: pt-serve retains one 8-byte TripUpdate per trip key plus merged/by_trip hash-map storage. StopTimeUpdates exercise decoding but collapse to the final delay. With no startDate, by_trip holds one clone of each bare trip id.
_regenerating: Run pnpm --filter @pt/backend generate:rt-fixtures, then run the fixture and Rust parser tests. Any generated-byte change requires a new same-runner poller-on/off capture; never infer memory numbers locally.
_shapeProvenance: Feed count, entity-type counts, StopTimeUpdate density, trip-id byte totals, and zero-startDate shape were retained from the superseded 2026-08-09 benchmark inputs. The identifiers and all protobuf bytes are generated here and contain no agency data.
_scope: Wire/parser/memory fixture only. Synthetic trip and stop ids intentionally do not claim to resolve against the production PTB staged by a runner; /health/rt proves ingestion, not overlay coverage.

_rights.reason: Original deterministic test data generated solely from numeric benchmark dimensions; no third-party identifiers or payload bytes are included.

_pollIntervalRationale: Matches pt-serve's deployed default, pinned by build.rs to RT_BACKEND_POLL_INTERVAL_MS.

feeds._note: Carries synthetic VehiclePosition entities so the TripUpdates poller's discard path remains exercised.

_expectedMergedEntries._comment: Expected /health/rt denominator. The v/a/m/t/g namespaces make all TripUpdate keys distinct across feeds.
